note: The root key uses the gentilic noun’s own consonants.
summary: אַרְוָדִי designates someone from Arvad. In Canaan’s genealogy the definite singular names the people collectively.

senses.definition: A member of the people of Arvad, or the people collectively.

evidence.note: The Arvadites appear alongside the Zemarites and Hamathites. The verse calls the groups in the list Canaanite clans.
